title: The Flamingo Flap
crime_description: All 37 plastic lawn flamingos along Maple Street were dressed in hand-knitted turtleneck sweaters overnight.
setting: The Pristine Suburban Lawns of Whisper Pines

suspect.name: Arthur Pendelton
suspect.quirk: Speaks exclusively in theatrical Shakespearean soliloquies.

dossier.text: Strands of rare emerald-green Shetland angora wool were snagged on the beak of flamingo #14.
The local hardware store clerk sold Arthur a pair of heavy aluminum wire-snippers at 6:30 PM.
Weather logs confirm a torrential rainstorm drenched Maple Street from midnight until 3:00 AM.

truth_timeline.event: Arthur buys wire-snippers to cut the flamingo lawn stakes.
Arthur slips out with a basket of green Shetland wool sweaters.
Arthur clothes all 37 flamingos in the driving rain, getting thoroughly soaked.

lie_plan.cover_story: Arthur claims he slumbered undisturbed beneath his eiderdown quilt through a crisp, dry, starry evening, that he works only with synthetic acrylic yarns, and hasn't bought hardware tools in forty winters.

weak_points.claim: I weave solely with modern synthetic polyester; coarse animal wool hath never touched mine artistic needles.
weak_points.planned_slip: Hark, vile slander! Mine immaculate hands touch only modest acrylic polymers; not a single strand of emerald Shetland wool exists in my demesne!

weak_points.claim: I have not entered a commercial ironmonger's shop nor touched metal shears in an epoch.
weak_points.planned_slip: Upon mine honor, I bought no rude iron clippers or wire shears at eventide! Such crude instruments are foreign to my poet soul!

weak_points.claim: The nocturnal firmament was as dry as parchment, with constellations glittering without a drop of rain.
weak_points.planned_slip: By the heavens, 'twas a night as arid as bone! The skies bore no deluge or rainstorm between midnight and dawn while I slumbered!

solution_contradictions: Suspect claims he never uses emerald Shetland wool, contradicting Fact 1 (emerald Shetland wool on flamingo).
Suspect claims he bought no tools or wire cutters, contradicting Fact 2 (wire-snippers purchased at 6:30 PM).
Suspect claims the night was bone-dry and star-lit, contradicting Fact 3 (torrential rainstorm midnight to 3 AM).
